title: AWKUM Signs MoU with AHZ Associates to Expand International Study Opportunities
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with AHZ Associates (Pakistan) to support students aspiring to pursue higher education abroad, particularly in the United Kingdom.

The MoU was signed by Dr. Muhammad Bilal, Director of the University Advancement & Career Development Center (UA&CDC) at AWKUM, and Mr. Asad Bashir, Regional Manager at AHZ Associates. The collaboration aims to enhance global exposure and create structured pathways for AWKUM students toward international education.

Under the agreement, AHZ Associates will provide free counseling, application guidance, and visa facilitation to AWKUM students. The partnership also includes support for securing scholarships of up to 40% for eligible students, discounted IELTS and PTE preparation, an on-campus help desk, and paid internship opportunities. AWKUM’s students will also benefit from interactions with international university representatives and free transportation to participate in educational expos organized by AHZ.
